subject: Mutual Action Plan & 90-day Milestone Crosswalk
messages:
From: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@pinegrove.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: devops@pinegrove.com
Date: 2028-11-18 09:12 PST
Subject: Kickoff — need MAP + milestone owners

Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Pinegrove is excited about Redwood's latency/cost controls. The exec team asked for a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) with milestone dates and named owners so we can present to procurement next week. Specifically we need:

- A 90-day timeline from provisioning to production acceptance
- Clear owners for API integration, security review, and data retention/retention scope
- Acceptance criteria for 'go-live' and fallback plan items

Can you send a draft MAP and a Gantt view by Wednesday 11/21? We have internal checkpoints on 11/28 and 12/19.

Also, our security lead wants confirmation on SOC2 artifact ownership during onboarding. Attaching our internal checklist for context (see attachment reference).

Best,
Aisha Kapoor
Head of Platform Integrations
Pinegrove Systems

Attachment: pinegrove_onboard_requirements.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@pinegrove.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-18 13:04 PST
Subject: Re: Kickoff — need MAP + milestone owners

Aisha — thanks, and appreciated the checklist. I'm attaching a draft MAP and a 90-day milestone crosswalk (xlsx + PNG) for your review. High level notes in the draft:

- Day 0–14: Provisioning + secure connectivity (owner: Redwood infra lead)
- Day 15–45: API integration & schema validation (owner: Pinegrove integration lead)
- Day 46–75: Performance tuning and KV cache alignment (owner: Redwood integration PM)
- Day 76–90: Acceptance testing and launch gating (owner: Pinegrove QA)

Request: can you confirm Pinegrove owners for API integration and QA, and let us know your security contact for SOC2 artifacts so Naomi can coordinate evidence handoff?

Next steps I'd suggest: 30-minute alignment call Tuesday 11/21 to lock owners and finalize dates. I've proposed a few slots in the calendar link below.

Draft attachments: Pinegrove_MAP_v1.xlsx, 90d_gantt_v2.png
P.S. Ben will run the kickoff and compile the runbook once owners are confirmed.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Scheduling: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123

Attachment: Pinegrove_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub); 90d_gantt_v2.png (image stub)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@pinegrove.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-19 08:37 PST
Subject: Re: Kickoff — need MAP + milestone owners

Thanks Marcus — adding a few operational details from CSM side that will be part of the MAP and acceptance checklist:

- Onboarding cadence: weekly 30-minute sync for first 6 weeks, then biweekly until launch
- Acceptance criteria (summary): stable latency within agreed profile for 48 hours, successful runbook dry-run, documented SLOs and escalation rota
- Security artifacts: Naomi to own SOC2 evidence collection from Redwood; Aisha to confirm Pinegrove's security reviewer (please share email and availability)
- Data retention: default 30-day KV cache retention unless Pinegrove requests custom TTL; we'll document in the runbook

Action items assigned in the updated MAP:
- API integration owner: Aisha Kapoor (Pinegrove) — confirm
- QA owner: Michael Ortiz (Pinegrove QA) — pending confirmation from Aisha
- Redwood infra owner for provisioning: Ben Carter
- Redwood integration PM for tuning: Soojin Lee

I've also attached a one-page checklist (onboarding-checklist.pdf) that we use for go/no-go calls. Once Pinegrove confirms owners, Ben will schedule the kickoff and share the runbook skeleton.

-naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference

Attachment: onboarding-checklist.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-11-21 16:05 PST

- Confirmed Pinegrove API owner: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@pinegrove.com>
- Confirmed Pinegrove QA owner: Michael Ortiz <m.ortiz@pinegrove.com> (added to thread)
- Redwood infra provisioning: Ben Carter (owner)
- Redwood integration & tuning: Soojin Lee (owner)
- Security liaison for SOC2 evidence: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@pinegrove.com> (confirmed)

Attachments: finalized MAP (Pinegrove_MAP_v1.xlsx) and updated Gantt (90d_gantt_v2.png). I've also created a shared runbook in Drive and sent invites for the weekly onboarding sync starting 2028-11-27 10:00 PST.

Key milestones (dates tentative, editable in shared sheet):
- Provisioning complete: 2028-11-30
- API integration complete: 2028-12-20
- Performance tuning complete: 2029-01-10
- Acceptance window start: 2029-01-11
- Production launch target: 2029-01-18

Immediate asks for Pinegrove:
1) Please add Michael Ortiz and Rajiv Menon to the shared Drive folder so Naomi can upload SOC2 evidence.
2) Confirm whether Pinegrove wants KV cache default TTL changed from 30 days (we'll implement if requested).

Thanks everyone — I'll keep the runbook updated and post short weekly notes after each sync. If anything urgent, ping me in Slack or reply-all.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Implementation Lead — Redwood Inference
